coder_notes: Registered as EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/2, translational subset). Phase 0 window dosing of pamiparib (Arms A, B) or olaparib (Arm C) before resection, with tumour tissue PK and PAR pharmacodynamics; PK responders proceed to Phase 2 with RT then TMZ maintenance. Arm C label text says 'pamiparib in combination with TMZ in the maintenance phase' whereas the TMZ intervention text says Arm C receives olaparib with TMZ - pamiparib listed for Arms A/B only. MGMT-unmethylated requirement applies to newly diagnosed Phase 2 cases (brief summary only, not in eligibility); coded enrichment for Arm A. Primary outcome title says 'plasma PK' but description specifies tumour tissue concentration.
